lower_description: flat solid bright green chroma-key color, one uniform green, no texture, no shading, no dithering
upper_description: raised rectangular parchment click plate for a 16-bit strategy game menu: aged cream-tan parchment paper face, ONE perfectly uniform flat cream-tan color across the whole face, absolutely zero texture: no fiber grain, no specks, no dots, no lines, no dashes, no rivets, no stitches, no inner borders, no creases, no blotches, no shading variation inside the plate, all detail strictly in the ornate outer frame: a wide bright polished brass band around the edge inlaid with a darker brass inner pinstripe and a small square brass stud pinned into the band at each corner, strong raised bevel lit from the top-left with a deep shadow on the bottom-right, retro 16-bit UI button in the style of classic 1990s naval adventure games like Uncharted Waters 2 / New Horizons, crisp deliberate pixels, flat color fills, no text
transition_description: raised polished brass rim with an inlaid darker brass pinstripe and square corner studs, ending in a crisp straight edge, Uncharted Waters 2 brass-bound parchment button edge
